remarks: This fully updated home is set back on parklike acre, accented by stone walls and gardens, located on a prime N. Stamford cul-de-sac. From the graceful entry, step into the large, sunny living room with bay window & crown moldings. The banquet sized dining room opens onto large updated kitchen with white cabinetry, s.s. appliances, granite countertops & breakfast area with bay window and built-ins. The bedroom wing features the primary bedroom with updated bath, wk-in closet & door to charming balcony. Corner bedroom also has access to private balcony, third bedroom and hall bath with designer tile accents complete this floor. Need an in-law, au pair or home office? Here's your opportunity as this great home has plenty of possibilities. The flexible lower level offers a huge family room with brick fireplace and two sets of French doors opening onto the large stone patio and charming gazebo. The former owners used to have kitchenette which was removed but all the plumbing was left inside the wall. In addition, there are two more bedrooms on this floor, one with an oversized walk in closet plus an additional bath and storage. Major mechanical improvements include 2023 central A/C and heat pump upstairs and also in the downstairs family room, 2024 hot water heater and oil tank . City water too!! List of improvements is too long (see attached list). Field card states 2,400 sq. ft. (actual sq. ft. is 3,000). Agents - please read agent remarks.
